''See also: [[Andel Petronus Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus, also known as Andel, is the [[Quartermaster]] and second-in-command to Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten. A [[Heartlander]] with dark skin, he is characterized by his pristine white suit and matching hat, as well as a silver [[White Sun pendant]] worn on his chest. He is described as an experienced traveler and the oldest companion of [[Calder]]'s crew, often acting as a voice of reason or a defender of the innocent. Though he possesses a calm and sometimes amused demeanor, even when facing danger or being restrained by enemies, he is also capable of intense command and decisive action. In his role aboard the ship, he provides direction and maintains order among the crew, which includes the alchemist [[Petal]] and the gunsmith [[Dalton Foster]]. He is proficient in combat, carrying both a [[sword]] and a pistol. Beyond his maritime duties, Andel has expressed interest in administrative roles within the Witnesses. He is known for his steadfastness and his tendency to advocate for mercy, though he can be quite forceful when issuing warnings or orders during emergencies.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel is a [[Heartlander]] man who typically wears a full white suit and hat. He carries silver accessories, including an [[amulet]] or medallion carved with the [[White Sun]] crest of the [[Luminian Order]]. At times, his suit may be stained and his hat missing.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|A highly skilled individual and former scribe, Andel is a determined man who is not easily dissuaded. He serves as Imperial Steward Calder Marten{{!}}Calder Marten's second-in-command and quartermaster, often fixing problems before they are noticed and maintaining a miserly grip on finances. His temperament ranges from gentle and quiet speech to shouting orders, and he has been known to display curiosity, dry amusement, or a lack of panic in tense situations.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel is a [[Navigator]] with decades of combat experience, proficient in using a pistol and a [[sword]]. He has demonstrated the ability to project [[white light]] from his outstretched hand and can utilize alchemical charge{{!}}alchemical charges.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Quartermaster on The Testament}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|Serving as [[Marten]]'s second-in-command, Andel Petronus holds the position of [[Quartermaster]].<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13">''Of Darkness and Dawn'', chapter 13</ref> His internal state is characterized by a mixture of curiosity, dry amusement, and an anticipation of danger.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">2</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Andel Petronus]] is [[Marten]]'s [[Quartermaster]] and second-in-command.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn|[[Andel Petronus]]'s intent is described as curiosity, anticipation of danger, and dry amusement.<ref name="ee-shadow-02-of-darkness-and-dawn-c13" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Petal]] felt that Andel would possess the necessary knowledge to handle Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine's situation.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 3</ref> He spoke with a gentle yet relentless manner and carried both a pistol and a [[White Sun medallion]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 4</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 8</ref> While sleeping in the main room, he was swallowed alive by a frog-like creature.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 10</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 12</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 16</ref> Although he was likely killed when the Slithers{{!}}Slither swallowed him, Andel was eventually released from the mouth of an Elder creature.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 14</ref> After being released, he sat with [[Jerri]] and adjusted his hat before reciting a list.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 15</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 17</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">11</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Petal]] believes Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel would know what to do regarding Jyrine Tessella Marten{{!}}Jyrine's situation.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel spoke gently but relentlessly.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c4" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel carries a pistol and a [[White Sun medallion]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c8" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel is sleeping in the main room.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c10" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel was swallowed by a frog-like creature.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c12" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Andel Petronus]] was swallowed and likely killed by a Slithers{{!}}Slither.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel was released from the mouth of an Elder creature.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel is sitting with [[Jerri]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c14" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel adjusted his hat.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c15" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel was swallowed alive.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c16" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus{{!}}Andel is reciting a list.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Estate worker and fugitive}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Andel Petronus was a man hired to labor on the estate of a noble family, wearing two medallions around his neck.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" /> Though he is not technically a [[Champion]], he is a wanted fugitive of the [[Luminian Order]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 19</ref> While in charge of driving citizens to a guarded checkpoint, he addressed [[Calder]] as [[Your Imperial Highness]] in a shaky voice.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref> After asking if [[Calder]] would recover, Andel was seen on the ramp and later the deck of [[The Testament]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c21">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref> While seated on the deck without his hat, he noted that [[Calder]] had moved to tears twice recently and whispered [[Light]] and life.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> Andel possesses a [[White Sun]] on his chest and can project [[white light]] from his outstretched hand.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">15</span></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Last crew member}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|As one of the final crew members serving under [[Calder]], Andel remained largely unmoved when [[Petal]] gasped.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25" /> During the events involving Dalton Foster{{!}}Foster's story, Andel was a witness to the tale.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 26</ref>}}

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“Only if you plan on shooting Andel, which I would wholeheartedly support.<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c1" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|Calder sighed and turned to face his Quartermaster. “Mister Petronus, what seems to be the problem?”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|“How do you expect the Elders to respond to an empty throne? They would feed on the chaos.”<ref name="ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow-c20" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Imperial prisoner,” Andel corrected, “under the supervision and probation of the Navigator’s Guild.”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c13" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Andel?” “Backup. I have a seat on the opposite side of the arena, and I will signal Foster if I notice something wrong.”<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c19" />}}
